OneTapCopy is not a notes app. It is a copy button for the text you send every day.

WHY NOT JUST USE NOTES?

- Notes: open the app, find the note, select the text, long-press, tap Copy. Four steps.
- OneTapCopy: tap the card. One step.

Notes are built to store text. OneTapCopy is built to hand it back to you fast.

WHAT IT DOES

- Tap a card to copy it instantly, with a short haptic buzz and a "Copied" toast
- Group snippets into categories, with 8 colors and 28 emoji to pick from
- Variable templates that fill themselves in as you copy: {{date}} and {{time}}, {{input:Label}} to type a value, {{choice:A|B|C}} to pick one, {{counter}} for a number that goes up on every copy
- Sort by newest, most used or last used, and pin the snippets you need at the top
- Search titles and bodies as you type
- Lock any snippet behind Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode; locked cards stay hidden until you authenticate, then stay open for five minutes
- Show a snippet as a QR code, or send it through the system share sheet
- When there is text on your clipboard, a banner offers to save it as a snippet
- Export and import a JSON backup to move everything to a new phone, merging or replacing what is there
- Dark mode, following the system or set by hand

Ready-made example categories are waiting at first launch, so you can see how it all works before writing anything of your own.

Everything stays on your device. No account, no sign-in, no cloud sync, no server.

Free, with a banner ad that never gets in the way of a copy, plus one full-screen ad a day when you save a category.

Type it once. Tap it forever. Keyboard Clipboard is a text expander keyboard for the things you type again and again: addresses, emails, phone numbers, links, bank details and ID numbers.

NEW IN 2.0: SMART IMPORT
Paste an email signature, a booking confirmation or a contact card and Smart Import pulls out every email, phone number, link, address and reference number, ready to save as snippets. On devices with Apple Intelligence, on-device AI gives each one a sensible name. On every other device, quick detection does the job offline. Nothing you paste leaves your device.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Save your snippets in the app, by hand or with Smart Import.
2. Turn on the Keyboard Clipboard keyboard in Settings and allow Full Access so it can read the snippets you saved.
3. In any app, switch to the keyboard and tap a snippet to type it.

FEATURES
• One-tap snippets in any app, color-coded and labelled (Address, Document, Link).
• Pinned favorites stay at the front of the keyboard.
• Filter the keyboard by label, and make the keys bigger or smaller.
• Siri and Shortcuts: copy a snippet, add a new one or run Smart Import by voice or from the Shortcuts app. Snippet names show up in Spotlight.
• Try the keyboard inside the app before you use it for real.
• A distinctive hand-drawn design, with full light and dark mode support.

PRIVACY
Your snippets are stored on your device, in a container shared only with the Keyboard Clipboard keyboard. The keyboard has no network code and never records or sends what you type. Full Access is needed only so the keyboard can read the snippets you saved in the app.

results.description:
Anything you type twice belongs in KeepText.

Addresses. Bank details. The reply you send five times a week. Prompts, code,
links, your kid's allergy list. Save it once — then paste it anywhere, without
leaving the app you're in.


THE KEEPTEXT KEYBOARD

This is the one that changes the day-to-day. Switch to the KeepText keyboard
inside Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Safari, Slack — anywhere you can type. Your
snippets are right there, ordered by what you actually use, so the one you
want is usually the first one. Tap it and the text lands at your cursor.

No app switching. No back-and-forth copy and paste. No losing your place.


SAVE IT IN UNDER A SECOND

- Share sheet — select text in any app, tap Share, choose KeepText. Done.
- Clipboard — copy something, open KeepText, and it offers to save it. One tap
  to keep, one tap to dismiss. It never reads your clipboard until you say yes.
- Type it — one field does both jobs. Search your library, and if nothing
  matches, that same field creates the snippet on the spot.


ONE TAP AWAY, EVERYWHERE ELSE TOO

- Widgets — home screen and lock screen. Tap to copy.
- Spotlight — swipe down anywhere and search your snippets by name.
- Shortcuts and Siri — "Save clipboard to KeepText," or add it to your Action
  button for one-press capture.


SEARCH THAT TELLS YOU THE TRUTH

Most apps guess. KeepText matches exactly — the word you typed, or the start
of it, and nothing looser. That sounds like a limitation until you use it: when
KeepText says nothing matched, it genuinely isn't saved yet, so you can create
it right there instead of wondering whether you're about to make a duplicate.


TEMPLATES

Put {{name}} or {{date}} anywhere in a snippet. When you use it, KeepText asks
you for the values and fills them in. Good for the email you send constantly
with one line that changes.


SYNCS EVERYWHERE. NO ACCOUNT. EVER.

Your snippets sync across your devices through your own iCloud account. There
is no KeepText account, no sign-up, no password, no server of ours in the
middle. Nothing to breach, because there's nowhere for your text to go.

The keyboard asks for Full Access because that is the only way iOS lets a
keyboard read the snippets stored on your own device. KeepText uses it for
exactly that. Nothing is collected, nothing is transmitted, there's no
analytics — the app has no account system to send anything to in the first
place. You can export everything you've saved to a plain JSON file whenever
you like.


FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PURCHASE

Keep up to 20 snippets free for as long as you want. One small purchase
unlocks unlimited snippets, forever. No subscription. No trial that quietly
starts charging. No ads.


NO FOLDERS

You'll notice there's no filing system. That's deliberate. Search and
frequency do the organizing, so saving something costs you one tap instead of
one decision — which is the whole reason your snippets actually get saved

results.description:
Ditto is a board of big, tappable squares. Each square holds a piece of text you use again and again — an order set, a template, an address, a reply you type ten times a day. Tap the square and the text is on your clipboard, ready to paste anywhere. The square flashes blue so you know it worked.

Made for anyone who types the same things every day: customer replies, sales follow-ups, order sets and clinic reference text, addresses, directions and sign-offs.

• Squares as big as your thumb — three across, as many as you need
• Folders, and folders inside folders, to group related texts
• The Ditto keyboard: your squares inside Messages, Mail, Notes and most other apps — tap one and the text is typed straight in, no copying. It works with "Full Access" left off.
• Combine quick taps (turn it on in Settings): tap several squares within 5 seconds and they're copied together, separated by a blank line
• Colors, borders, emoji or photos on any square
• Chat buttons that jump straight into a Messages conversation
• Link to the web: edit your board on a computer at dittotap.com/link, end-to-end encrypted
• Share a board: export it as a file, and anyone with Ditto can open it from the Share button
• [TODAY], [TOMORROW] and [TIME] become the real date or time when copied
• Hold a square to arrange: drag to reorder or drop it onto a folder; tap its ⋯ badge to edit · Light or dark board · English + 16 more languages

PRIVACY — WE COLLECT NOTHING
Ditto collects no information whatsoever. No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. Your squares live on your phone. The keyboard works with "Full Access" left off and never uses the internet, so nothing you type can leave your device.
Link to the web is the only feature that goes online, and it's off until you turn it on. Your board is encrypted on your iPhone before it's sent, so our relay can't read it, and the copy is erased 30 days after the last change.

PRICE
New downloads get Ditto free for their first 4 months (anyone who started using Ditto before version 1.4 keeps a full free year). After that, Ditto Pro is $4.99 per year (auto-renewable) and keeps every square, folder, picture and the keyboard working. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
